pages.text: [#](53341a)The crystal ball does not tell you what you want to hear. It tells you what it perceives — oblique, contextual, and occasionally alarming. Right-click it empty-handed near an altar holding at least 500 power for a reading.[#]()
pages.title: The Crystal Ball

pages.text: [#](53341a)There is a cooldown between readings; the ball will not repeat itself. Whether that is a limitation or a mercy is a matter of interpretation.[#]()
[#](53341a)Infuse it at night on a small circle. Offer a Gold Ingot and Happenstance Oil, and keep 2000 altar power ready.[#]()
pages.title: Quartz Sphere

pages.text: [#](53341a)The rite returns a Crystal Ball attuned for fortune work. Use it near a powered altar, or focus it with waystones and taglocks. Bad foci are refused before the altar is charged; a true focus wakes the ball with violet motes.[#]()
pages.title: Crystal Ball

pages.text: [#](53341a)A filled Taglock taken from the resident of a Vanishing Hut catches a different vision. Even when witch and house are beyond waking sight, the glass may show the realm, the sort of country, and the temper of the sky around them.[#]()
pages.title: A House Through Glass

pages.text: [#](53341a)It gives no road, bearing, distance, or coordinates. The house keeps some secrets even from glass.[#]()
